doc_summary: using an item over time, as vanilla's `Item.getUseDuration`, `getUseAnimation` and `finishUsingItem` and NeoForge's `LivingEntityUseItemEvent.Start` and `.Finish`. `native_use_duration` answers a stack's use time: a mod's own item with no use of vanilla's that answers above 0 is used over time on a right click, until it is let go or the time runs out, on single player, LAN and in-frame alike. `native_use_animation` picks the first person pose of a use (eat, drink, bow, trident, brush), and `native_can_eat` decides whether a food can be eaten now. `native_living_entity_use_item_start` may change a use's duration or refuse it, on the server and where the window's client predicts the use, and on the server `native_living_entity_use_item_finish` may replace what the hand holds once the time ran out (consumables, potions and mods' items). Both take the using entity, None for a player, so mobs can fire them later, and the hand in use. Change the world only where this game runs the world, not on a server's client. Bundles that use them need `"hooks": @API:item_use_over_time@`.
